name: Brickmap SDF Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that represents 3D scenes as CSG trees of SDF primitives, evaluates distances on the CPU, compresses the resulting 3D distance field into a Brickmap structure, and raymarches through it on the GPU.
summary: Brickmap SDF Volume Rendering evaluates CSG trees on the CPU and compresses the result into a sparse Brickmap, reducing memory usage by 10-100x while avoiding GPU branching overhead.
